goal_intent: work out whether to eat here this weekend, then book if it suits

turns.utterance: Hi there! I’m planning a little get-together with some friends this weekend and was wondering if your place is any good for a group? We've heard good things but wanted to check before making any plans.
Thanks! There’ll be five of us—it’s just a small group, but we wanted somewhere comfortable for catching up and sharing a meal. Is that size easy to accommodate?

That sounds great, thanks! Before you transfer me, could you let me know if you’re open on Sunday evenings? That’s when we’re hoping to come by, since everyone’s free then and it’d be a nice way to wrap up the weekend.
Sure thing! We were thinking about 6:30pm, since it’s early enough for a relaxed dinner but late enough that everyone can make it after their weekend plans. Is that a good time for your place?
Absolutely, thanks for checking! The booking should be under Marcus Bell. I’m really looking forward to this—everyone’s been talking about it all week.
That’s perfect, thank you so much! I think that covers everything—we’re just excited for a nice evening together. Have a great day and see you Sunday! [END OF CALL]
